  1. Show HN: Live map of U.S. flights during tonight's FAA nationwide ground stop

    • Aviation
    • Data Visualization
    • Maps

    220 points · 27 comments · 13 Nov 2026, 23:17 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — grounds.top is an unofficial, live-and-replayable visualization of the November 13, 2026 FAA nationwide ground stop. It compares U.S. tracked commercial flight activity with the same time a week earlier, using adsb.fi community ADS-B positions and FAA NAS Status delay data, while explaining that it is a consistent sample rather than an official count.

    Discussion — Commenters praised the rapid turnaround and noted the irony that aircraft-broadcast ADS-B data could still show the situation during an FAA outage. The maker said the site was generated with Claude Code in roughly 30 minutes and then cleaned up. Questions covered the data source, aircraft coverage, apparent speed, and the ground stop's cause.

  2. Show HN: Isometric SF – A pixel-art map of the SF Bay Area

    • Design
    • Maps

    256 points · 76 comments · 13 Nov 2026, 17:58 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — An interactive, isometric map of the San Francisco Bay Area rendered in a pixel-art-like visual style. The public landing page provides the map and a link to a making-of page, but exposes little implementation detail in its initial rendered text.

    Discussion — The dominant discussion was whether the imagery qualifies as pixel art: critics cited anti-aliasing and generative-image artifacts, while others praised the map and recognized locations. Commenters also asked for north-oriented or rotatable views; one identified Google photorealistic 3D tiles as the underlying imagery.
